title: Field-valued etale sheaf tensor preserves cohomological bounds
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], k a field, and C an etale complex of k-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If H^q(C)=0 outside an integral interval [a,b], then the same interval bounds the homology of sfbEtaleTensorDegreeZero(X,k,C,N) [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data] for every degree-zero etale k-module sheaf N. No constructibility, Noetherianity or strict termwise bounds are assumed.

source.place: Remark 6.3.2 and the field-coefficient observation in the proof of the integral criterion

proof.text: Presheaf tensor is computed sectionwise. Every vector space is flat, so evaluation after tensor preserves finite limits. The sheaf tensor comparison identifies tensor with presheaf tensor followed by exact sheafification. Thus sheaf tensor preserves finite limits. The reflected closed monoidal structure also makes tensor a left adjoint, so it preserves finite colimits.

The exact-functor homology isomorphism identifies homology of the tensor complex with tensor of the homology sheaf. Apply the functor to each zero homology sheaf and transport zero along this isomorphism, for every N and every outside degree.

lean.statement:
theorem sfbFieldTensor_bounds (X : Scheme.{u}) (k : Type (u + 1)) [Field k]
    (C : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)) ℤ)
    (a b : ℤ) (h : ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) → IsZero (C.homology q)) :
    ∀ (N : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)) (q : ℤ),
      (q < a ∨ b < q) → IsZero ((sfbEtaleTensorDegreeZero X k C N).homology q)
